verdict.rationale: Pinecone ships an AI assistant product, so consuming external MCP servers is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence only documents Pinecone acting as an MCP server that external agents connect to. That is the opposite role and does not transfer to this MCP-client story. Nothing in the pack shows Pinecone (or Pinecone Assistant) connecting to or using tools from third-party MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
